ui.gameTitle: Moongirl was in love with the ocean

script.l1: A café at dusk. Outside the window, it has started to rain.
script.l2: Hey, do you know whose umbrella this is?
script.l3: No idea. But it's been sitting there for ages, hasn't it?
script.l4: Want to try finding its owner?
script.l5: This is a small story that begins with a single forgotten umbrella.
script.l6: Mio and Kai are two friends who meet at a café on a rainy evening. As they sit by the window, they notice a forgotten umbrella and decide to find its owner, leading them on an unexpected adventure.
script.l7: Lala joins them on their quest, bringing her own unique perspective to the adventure.

mg.title: Moongirl was in love with the ocean

s1.intro: Moongirl is staring at the ocean...
s1.walks: She starts walking toward the sea.
s1.reach: You reach for Moongirl, but she starts walking toward the sea.
s1.watch: You watch as she walks toward the sea.

s2.swim: It looks like she wants to take a swim. You could join her if you want.
s2.stay: You stay in the soft safety of the sand.
s2.dissolve: As Moongirl reaches the ocean, she starts dissolving into the water.
s2.wave: She uses her last breath to become a wave. It breaks on the shore and disappears.

s3.feet: You both dip your feet in the water. You take a moment to look around.
